lines: Willie: Hey, you look like a trainer passing through! Let's have a quick battle at the stand.

intro: Willie: Hey, you look like a trainer passing through! Let's have a quick battle at the stand.
player_won: Willie: Whoa! You're the real thing!

lines: You rev the motorbike and race across the dunes.
Sand sprays behind you. Orre has no tall grass, only desert, rock and wind.
Men in strange uniforms are scaring people at the fountain!
Cipher Peon: Orre belongs to Cipher! Our Shadow Pokemon can't be stopped!

player_won: Peon: Retreat! Tell the admins a trainer with real Pokemon is here!

done: The fountain sparkles again. Phenac is safe, for now.

lines: Rui: You beat them! Did you see that dark aura? Those were Shadow Pokemon.
Cipher closes Pokemon's hearts so they only want to fight. It's so cruel!
Team Snagem left this machine behind when Cipher took over: a Snag Machine.
With it you can catch a Shadow Pokemon from a Cipher trainer and save it!
Take Shadow Pokemon to the Relic Stone in Agate Village to open their hearts.
Snattle: As the former mayor, I welcome you... to your defeat!

intro: Snattle: As the former mayor, I welcome you... to your defeat!
player_won: Snattle: How dare you!

intro: Welcome to the final round of the Phenac Stadium! The winner takes the Phenac Badge!
player_won: You won the Phenac Stadium! Here's the Phenac Badge!
player_lost: So close! Train up and enter the next tournament.

requirements.fail_text: The tournament isn't open to you yet. Keep following Cipher's trail!

ORRE_POKE_SPOTS.description: Three Poké Spots in the desert (Rock, Oasis and Cave), where wild Pokémon come for Poké Snacks. A Munchlax turns up now and then.

lines: Sheriff: Pyrite's a rough town, kid. Outlaws on every corner.
Lately Cipher's been running things from The Under, the old city below us.
Clear them out and Agate Village will want to meet you.

intro: Welcome to the final round of the Pyrite Colosseum! The winner takes the Pyrite Badge!
player_won: You won the Pyrite Colosseum! Here's the Pyrite Badge!
player_lost: So close! Train up and enter the next tournament.

requirements.fail_text: The tournament isn't open to you yet. Keep following Cipher's trail!

lines: Miror B.: Ah-ha! A trainer dancing into MY hideout? My Ludicolo will show you some real moves!

player_won: Miror B.: Unbelievable! Fine, go to Agate Village. See if I care!

lines: Elder Eagun: So you're the trainer who saved Pyrite. Rui told me everything.
The Relic Stone in our forest can open a Shadow Pokemon's heart. Use it whenever you need.
Cipher's leader hides in Realgam Tower. When you're ready, end this.
Elder Eagun: The Relic Stone can open a Shadow Pokemon's heart, if you wish it.
Some trainers keep their Shadow Pokemon as they are. Choose one to purify, or none.

fail: The Relic Stone glows softly. The forest feels like it's waiting for something.
lines: Every Shadow Pokemon you saved gathers around the Relic Stone.
A shooting star falls into the forest... and a tiny Pokemon with a star on its head wakes up!
It's Jirachi, the Wish Pokemon. It looks at you, curious.

boss.name: Ho-Oh
lines: Every Shadow Pokemon in Orre has been set free. A rainbow arcs over the Relic Stone...
Ho-Oh descends, drawn by the hearts you opened!
Mt. Battle Master Vander: You beat all ten areas? Then face the master of the mountain!

player_won: Vander: What a climb! You're the true master of Mt. Battle!

lines: Mt. Battle's trainers are ready for another round. Back to Area 1!
Dakim: Mt. Battle belongs to Cipher now! Out of my way!

intro: Dakim: Mt. Battle belongs to Cipher now! Out of my way!
player_won: Dakim: Grr... You'll pay for that at Realgam!

lines: Cipher Admin Venus: How dare you march into my studio!
My Shadow Pokemon are beautiful, and you'll see how beautiful in battle!

player_won: Venus: My makeup... ruined! Fine, The Under is yours!

intro: Welcome to the final round of the Under Colosseum! The winner takes the Under Badge!
player_won: You won the Under Colosseum! Here's the Under Badge!
player_lost: So close! Train up and enter the next tournament.

requirements.fail_text: The tournament isn't open to you yet. Keep following Cipher's trail!

shadow_pool.note: Ein's Kanto experiment (not in the games)

shadow_pool.name: Shadow Charmander
shadow_pool.note: Ein's Kanto experiment (not in the games)

shadow_pool.name: Shadow Squirtle
shadow_pool.note: Ein's Kanto experiment (not in the games)

lines: Ein: You found my laboratory. Then you'll become my next experiment!

intro: Ein: You found my laboratory. Then you'll become my next experiment!
player_won: Ein: My research... ruined!

lines: Sailor: Cipher's back, they say. New Shadow Pokemon, and a ship nobody can find.
Start at their lab outside town. Then the ONBS building, the Key Lair... and Citadark Isle.
Professor Krane: Welcome to the Pokemon HQ Lab! We're studying how to purify Shadow Pokemon.
Cipher is turning Pokemon into fighting machines. We could use a trainer like you.
Please take this Eevee. It's a good partner, and it can become many things.
Cipher Admin Lovrina: You found my lab? My lovely Shadow Pokemon will deal with you!

player_won: Lovrina: Ugh! Fine, the ONBS building is next. Not that it'll help you!

lines: Cipher Commander Exol: The Orre news station is ours. Shadow Pokemon on every channel!

player_won: Exol: Broadcast cut... The Key Lair in Pyrite holds the real secrets.

lines: Gonzap: You walked off with our Snag Machine. Team Snagem wants it back!

intro: Gonzap: You walked off with our Snag Machine. Team Snagem wants it back!
player_won: Gonzap: Ha! Fine, keep it. You've earned it.

intro: Welcome to the final round of the Orre Colosseum! The winner takes the Orre Badge!
player_won: You won the Orre Colosseum! Here's the Orre Badge!
player_lost: So close! Train up and enter the next tournament.

requirements.fail_text: The tournament isn't open to you yet. Keep following Cipher's trail!

lines: Cipher Admin Gorigan: Here's where Cipher keeps its keys. You'll go no further!

player_won: Gorigan: The key... to Citadark Isle. Take it, then. Greevil is waiting.

intro: Evice: So you're the meddler. Realgam Tower is mine, and so is Orre!
player_won: Evice: Impossible... Cipher is finished.
Rui: You did it! Every Shadow Pokemon can be saved now!
player_lost: Evice: Cipher cannot be beaten! Leave my tower!

requirements.fail_text: Realgam Tower's doors are sealed. Win all four tournaments first!

lines: The files list the Shadow Pokemon Cipher made here.
One note says: "A wishing star fell near Agate's Relic Stone. Investigate."
Another: "Project XD: ship the new Shadow Pokemon through Gateon Port."
Snattle: I was Phenac's mayor once. Now I serve Cipher, and you'll go no further!

player_won: Snattle: ...Father, I'm sorry.

lines: Ardos: Greevil is our father. I will not let you reach him.

player_won: Ardos: ...Father, I'm sorry.

lines: Eldes: Brother Ardos has fallen? Then I will stop you myself.

player_won: Eldes: ...Father, I'm sorry.

lines: Grand Master Greevil: So you crossed the sea to my island. Cipher will rule Orre!

player_won: Greevil: My Shadow Pokemon... my perfect plan... Cipher is finished!

fail: Greevil's admins guard the way. Beat Snattle, Ardos and Eldes first.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Welcome to Orre
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cipher Peons are attacking Phenac City's fountain. Stop them and meet Rui.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Pyrite and The Under
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cipher runs Pyrite Town from The Under. Snag their Shadow Pokemon and beat Admin Venus.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Realgam Tower
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Purify your Shadow Pokemon at Agate's Relic Stone, then take down Cipher at Realgam Tower.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Wishing Star
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cipher's files mention a wishing star near Agate's Relic Stone.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Mt. Battle
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Climb Mt. Battle near Pyrite Town: 40 trainers in 10 areas, then Mt. Battle Master Vander. Climb again any time.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Gale of Darkness
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cipher is back under Greevil. Clear the lairs from Gateon Port and stop him on Citadark Isle.
